title: Three sets cannot all be large under symmetric difference
statement: Let $S,T,U$ be subsets of an $n$-element set. If $S=T\mathbin{\triangle}U$ and each of $S,T,U$ has cardinality strictly greater than $2n/3$, then these conditions are impossible.
hypotheses_covered: $S,T,U$ are finite subsets of an $n$-element set
